hits.text:
You can win a customer on Google and still lose them when they ask ChatGPT whether they should buy.

In fact, nearly 60% of customers now say that talking to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and so forth convinced them *not* to purchase something.

That means there is a huge opportunity https://t.co/hcrDpOq2m9 https://t.co/cSQ4HaLjoa

drafts.type: test outdoor GFCI before holiday lights
drafts.text:
Before the holiday lights go up, test your outdoor outlets.

Press TEST on the GFCI, then RESET. If it won't trip or won't reset, it isn't protecting you from a shock.

That's a quick fix for a licensed electrician.

SoLit Electric, Baton Rouge. 225-472-1165

Smell something like burning plastic near an outlet or your panel?

Don't wait it out. If you can do it safely, shut that breaker off, and call a licensed electrician.

SoLit Electric has 24/7 emergency service in Baton Rouge. 225-472-1165

Buying an older home in Baton Rouge?

Ask about the electrical panel before you close. An outdated or overloaded panel can turn into a big bill after move-in.

Licensed master electrician Yancie David can look it over.

SoLit Electric. 225-472-1165
